title: Senior SEO Executive
description:
Sr. SEO Executive

**Experience:** 4 to 7 Years  
**Department:** Digital Marketing / SEO  
**Reporting To:** Digital Marketing Manager

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced, data-driven Senior SEO Executive to join our growing digital marketing team. The ideal candidate will develop, implement, and manage complete search strategies that drive organic growth, improve keyword rankings, and generate qualified leads.

The role also covers brand visibility across traditional search engines and AI-powered search platforms such as Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot.

You will work closely with the content, design, and development teams to apply SEO and AI-search best practices across all digital channels and markets (USA, UK, Australia, GCC and global).

Key Responsibilities1. On-Page Optimization

* Conduct comprehensive website audits and identify improvement opportunities.
* Optimize web pages, service pages, blogs, and landing pages for targeted keywords, topics, and search intent.
* Ensure proper implementation of meta tags, header tags, schema markup, alt text, and internal linking.
* Collaborate with content writers to create helpful, people-first content aligned with Google's E-E-A-T guidelines (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness).
* Build topical authority through pillar pages, topic clusters, and entity-based content planning.
* Improve site structure, crawlability, and user experience to enhance rankings.
* Monitor Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), site speed, and mobile-first performance.
* Regularly refresh and update existing content to prevent ranking decay.

2. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) / AI Search Visibility

* Develop strategies to improve brand visibility and citations in AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot.
* Structure content for AI extraction: clear answers, FAQs, comparison tables, statistics, and well-organized passages.
* Strengthen entity signals (brand, services, people, and locations) through schema, Knowledge Panel optimization, and consistent brand information across the web.
* Track brand mentions, citations, and share of voice across AI platforms using appropriate tools.
* Manage AI crawler access (robots.txt for GPTBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, etc.) and evaluate emerging standards such as llms.txt.
* Optimize for Bing (Bing Webmaster Tools, IndexNow), as it powers several AI search experiences.

3. Off-Page Optimization and Digital PR

* Develop and execute quality link-building strategies, including guest posts, outreach, digital PR, and data-led content.
* Build relationships with relevant websites, industry publications, journalists, and influencers.
* Drive unlinked brand mentions and listings on review and directory platforms (Clutch, GoodFirms, G2, etc.), which influence both SEO and AI recommendations.
* Manage link profile health and perform backlink audits to identify and handle toxic or spammy links.
* Monitor competitors' backlink and PR strategies and identify new opportunities.
* Ensure all link-building complies with Google's spam policies.

4. Technical SEO

* Work with the development team to fix crawling, indexing, rendering, and other technical issues.
* Monitor XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, redirects, and hreflang for multi-region sites.
* Audit JavaScript rendering and indexing for modern frameworks (React, Next.js, etc.).
* Implement and validate structured data (Organization, Service, FAQ, Article, Breadcrumb, Review, etc.).
* Conduct log file analysis and crawl budget optimization where needed.
* Optimize website architecture for better indexing and ranking performance.
* Run regular technical audits and support SEO quality checks during website migrations and redesigns.

5. Keyword Strategy and Analytics

* Conduct in-depth keyword and topic research covering short-tail, long-tail, conversational, and question-based queries.
* Map keywords and topics to content and pages based on search intent and funnel stage.
* Track keyword performance, SERP feature ownership, and zero-click trends.
* Set up and manage tracking in GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, and Looker Studio dashboards.
* Measure organic contribution to leads and pipeline (form fills, MQLs, SQLs) together with the sales and CRM teams.
* Generate detailed SEO performance reports covering traffic, rankings, AI visibility, conversions, and ROI.

6. AI Tools and Process Efficiency

* Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) responsibly for research, content briefs, outlines, schema generation, and audit automation.
* Ensure all AI-assisted content is reviewed, fact-checked, and edited to meet quality and E-E-A-T standards.
* Build repeatable SOPs, templates, and automation to improve team productivity.

7. Team Management

* Lead, guide, and mentor junior and mid-level SEO executives.
* Assign daily tasks, monitor performance, and ensure timely deliverables.
* Conduct training sessions to upskill team members on SEO tools, AI search, and industry trends.
* Coordinate with the content, design, development, and PPC teams to implement SEO plans.
* Review team reports and provide actionable feedback for improvement.

8. Reporting and Strategy

* Present monthly performance and progress reports to management.
* Suggest and implement data-driven strategies for continuous improvement.
* Monitor Google core updates, spam updates, and AI search changes, and adjust strategy quickly.
* Stay updated on SEO tools, AI search developments, and emerging digital marketing trends.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Growth in organic website traffic and engaged sessions.
* Improvement in keyword rankings (Top 10 / Top 3) and SERP feature ownership.
* Growth in brand visibility and citations in AI search platforms (AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc.).
* Increase in organic leads, conversions, and pipeline contribution.
* Growth in quality referring domains and brand mentions.
* Core Web Vitals and technical health scores.
* Timely completion of audits and optimization tasks.
* Team performance and delivery quality.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, IT, Communications, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of proven experience in SEO (agency or in-house), ideally in B2B, IT services, or SaaS.
* Strong knowledge of on-page, off-page, and technical SEO.
* Working knowledge of GEO/AEO and how AI search platforms select and cite sources.
* Solid understanding of E-E-A-T, helpful content principles, and Google's spam policies.
* Hands-on experience with SEO tools: Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, Bing Webmaster Tools, Moz, etc.
* Experience with AI visibility tracking tools (e.g., Semrush AI Toolkit, Ahrefs Brand Radar, Profound, or similar).
* Familiarity with CMS platforms (WordPress, Shopify, Magento, headless CMS).
* Analytical mindset with strong reporting and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and junior SEO team management abilities.

Preferred Skills

* Knowledge of HTML/CSS/JavaScript basics for SEO implementation.
* Experience in international SEO (UK, Australia, US markets, hreflang), local SEO, and eCommerce SEO.
* Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), analytics tracking, and attribution.
* Experience with programmatic SEO and large-scale content operations.

description:
**What You Will Own**

You will own organic growth across Ebizfiling’s priority business verticals, including:

* Company Registration in India
* LLP, OPC and Section 8 Registration
* Annual Filings and Compliance
* GST, Income Tax and Accounting
* Retainer Compliance Services
* Indian Subsidiary and Foreign\-Owned Company Registration
* USA Company Registration
* Trademark and other business compliance services

Your responsibility goes beyond rankings and traffic. You should be able to identify which searches have commercial value, which pages generate qualified leads, where Ebizfiling is losing visibility, and what should be prioritised to improve business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Organic Growth Strategy**

* Build and execute an organic growth strategy aligned with Ebizfiling’s priority services and revenue goals.
* Identify opportunities based on commercial intent, lead potential, competitive landscape and achievable upside.
* Prioritise high\-value opportunities instead of chasing search volume for its own sake.
* Create measurable growth plans for priority service pages, content clusters and emerging search opportunities.
* Strengthen topical and category authority across registrations, taxation, accounting and compliance.

**2\. SEO \& Search Performance**

* Improve visibility across high\-intent commercial, transactional and informational searches.
* Analyse search demand, SERPs, competitors, keyword opportunities and content gaps.
* Improve existing service pages, landing pages, blogs and knowledge content based on user intent and business value.
* Identify and resolve keyword cannibalisation, thin content, duplicate content, weak internal linking and underperforming high\-potential pages.
* Build strategies around user intent and conversion potential rather than rankings alone.

**3\. AI Search \& Generative Discovery**

Search is expanding beyond traditional Google results. You should understand how visibility is evolving across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and other AI\-powered search and answer platforms.

* Develop strategies for Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and AI Search visibility.
* Improve entity authority, semantic relevance, structured answers, source credibility and AI\-readable content architecture.
* Identify opportunities for Ebizfiling to become a trusted source that search engines and AI systems can surface, reference and recommend.
* Track and test changes in AI\-driven discovery and adapt the organic strategy accordingly.

**4\. Lead Generation \& Conversion**

SEO at Ebizfiling is treated as a customer\-acquisition channel, not a traffic\-only function.

**THE FUNNEL**

Search → Landing Page → Engagement → Enquiry → Qualified Lead → Customer

* Identify high\-traffic pages that fail to generate enquiries or qualified leads.
* Improve conversion paths, calls to action and service\-page journeys.
* Identify high\-intent queries with weak commercial outcomes and diagnose why.
* Convert relevant informational traffic into commercial opportunities without compromising content usefulness.
* Measure lead quality and business contribution, not just traffic volume.

**5\. Content, Authority \& Accuracy**

* Lead search\-intent mapping, content\-gap analysis, topic clustering, content briefs and content upgrades.
* Improve internal linking, FAQs, structured answers and content consolidation.
* Regularly identify outdated pages affected by changes in laws, government forms, filing requirements, due dates, fees, tax provisions, thresholds or compliance procedures.
* Prefer improving valuable existing assets over publishing large volumes of low\-value content.
* Work with subject\-matter and internal teams to ensure content remains accurate, useful and commercially relevant.

**6\. AI\-Assisted SEO**

* Use AI tools for research, search\-intent analysis, competitor intelligence, content\-gap discovery, topic clustering, briefs, FAQs, internal\-linking opportunities, data analysis and experimentation.
* Build efficient AI\-assisted workflows without compromising accuracy, originality or subject expertise.
* Know where AI improves productivity and where human judgement is essential.
* Avoid mass\-generated commodity content that adds little value to users or the brand.

**7\. Technical SEO**

* Diagnose crawling, indexation, canonicalisation, redirect and sitemap issues.
* Review structured data, robots directives, Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile SEO and site architecture.
* Identify duplicate\-content and JavaScript\-related SEO issues where relevant.
* Work effectively with developers and ensure recommended technical fixes are implemented correctly.

**8\. Analytics \& Competitive Intelligence**

* Use Search Console, analytics and SEO platforms to identify opportunities, diagnose losses and measure outcomes.
* Analyse which competitors are gaining visibility, why their pages outperform ours and where they remain vulnerable.
* Connect organic performance to enquiries, lead quality and revenue wherever tracking permits.
* Translate SEO data into clear actions and business priorities.

**Tools \& Platforms**

Strong hands\-on experience with a practical combination of the following is expected:

* Google Search Console and Google Analytics / GA4
* Ahrefs, Semrush, Ubersuggest or similar SEO research platforms
* Screaming Frog and technical SEO tools
* PageSpeed Insights and Google Trends
* Looker Studio or similar analytics/reporting tools
* ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity or comparable AI platforms

**WHAT MATTERS**

Knowing the tools is expected. Knowing what decisions to make from the data is what matters.

**Experience \& Candidate Profile**

* **Minimum experience:** At least 2 years of hands\-on experience in SEO, Organic Growth, Search Growth or a closely related role.
* **Evidence of impact:** You should be able to explain measurable improvements you personally influenced—traffic quality, leads, conversions, revenue, visibility or similar outcomes.
* **Commercial thinking:** You understand that useful organic growth is about capturing the right demand, not maximising vanity metrics.
* **AI awareness:** You actively understand how AI is changing search, content discovery and user behaviour.
* **Ownership:** You can independently identify problems, prioritise opportunities, test solutions and measure results.
* **Analytical mindset:** You are comfortable working with data and questioning assumptions.

Strong capability and demonstrated ownership matter more to us than the exact number of years on a résumé.

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per year

title: Lead - Sales & Marketing
description:
### **Responsibilities**


**Executive \- Closing**


**Prospecting and Lead Generation:**



Proactively identify and qualify leads in designated markets through high\-volume B2B and B2C sales calls.



Aggressively seek new business opportunities and expand the client network to rapidly achieve revenue targets.



Continuously drive urgency for repurchase and referrals, ensuring a strong and fast\-moving sales pipeline.


**Client Engagement and Relationship Management:**



Swiftly attend to customers, negotiate effectively, and close deals within defined timelines to meet month\-on\-month revenue goals.



Ensure immediate follow\-ups to maintain engagement and convert interest into sales without delay.



Proactively push for faster closures through regular meetings with channel partners, driving engagement and empanelment for increased business.


**Sales Process and Support:**



Work with a sense of urgency alongside the Team Lead to convert proposals into confirmed sales through quick and effective site visits.



Minimize decision delays by actively addressing customer concerns and ensuring rapid communication of product knowledge.



Drive fast\-tracked customer engagement, resolving queries immediately and ensuring smooth movement through the sales funnel.


**Industry Awareness:**



Keep abreast of relevant competitor details, including price movements, construction activity, key trends, and market dynamics.



Network effectively with peer teams and industry contacts to stay updated on key developments and potential business opportunities.



Liaise with various departments to gain deeper product knowledge and insights.


**Team Collaboration:**



Support peer teams in effective deal closure, ensuring all required documents (legal agreements, billing, credit, etc.) are in place and monitor collections for designated accounts.



Coordinate with departments (Customer Care, Sales \& Marketing, Projects, etc.) to ensure exceptional customer service and experience.


**Systems and Process Compliance:**



Maintain accurate records for designated accounts and share regular updates with the Team Lead and Area Sales Manager.



Ensure thorough adherence to SFDC and lead tracking mechanisms as required.



Comply with the highest standards of Sales Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), policies, and processes.


**Financial Management:**



Maintain accurate records for designated accounts and provide regular updates to the Segment Head.



Monitor collections for designated accounts and ensure timely payments.


**Strategic Sales Management:**



Drive the overall sales strategy for the region, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and AOP targets.



Analyze market trends to identify opportunities for growth and expansion.



Collaborate with project heads to set clear sales objectives and performance metrics to achieve the broader organizational objectives.


**Operational Oversight:**



Ensure all project sites within the cluster are running smoothly and efficiently as per the plan.



Ensure regular visits are conducted to each site to assess performance and provide guidance, wherever necessary.



Implement standardized processes across sites to enhance operational efficiency.



Oversee the performance of Channel Partners (CP) within the cluster, ensuring that regular engagement and meetings are conducted to drive business results.



Monitor CP performance metrics and facilitate improvements as necessary.


**New Business Development:**



Identify and pursue new business opportunities at each project site.



Leverage existing client relationships and market insights to generate leads.



Encourage project heads to actively participate in B2B and B2C sales initiatives.



Develop and implement go\-to\-market (GTM) strategies for new product launches, and work with the CRM team for creation of right pricing and offers.



Coordinate marketing discussions to determine the best channels for advertising.


**Stakeholder Liaison:**


* Liaise with internal and Key Stakeholders \- External:, including site engineers and CRM teams, to ensure seamless project execution and address any operational challenges.


* Establish effective communication channels to facilitate timely updates and feedback.


* Work collaboratively with various departments to optimize customer service and operational support.



Financial Performance Management


* Monitor topline performance across all projects within the cluster and provide regular updates to senior management.


* Analyze sales data to identify trends and undertake strategic decisions, to support the business.


* Adjust pricing strategies based on market conditions and competitive landscape.



Team Leadership and Development


* Lead, mentor, and support project heads and sales teams to achieve their targets.


* Foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and accountability



Compliance and Reporting


* Ensure adherence to organizational policies and sales SOPs across all projects.



• Maintain accurate records of sales activities and provide regular reports to management• Provide ongoing guidance to the team to ensure they are well\-equipped to meet business objectives.


* Ensure team engagement, motivation, and consistent drive towards achieving set targets.

title: CHIEF SALES & Marketing Officer
description:
### **Responsibilities**


**Strategic Leadership**


* Develop and execute a comprehensive sales and marketing strategy aligned with business objectives and revenue targets.
* Lead and guide the heads of key functions, ensuring cohesive strategy implementation and performance.
* Participate in executive and strategic discussions to shape the company’s direction and goals.


**Revenue Growth**


* Drive strategies to increase cements and allied products sales, focusing on new business acquisition and customer retention.
* Implement dynamic sales plans based on market trends, customer needs, and competitive analysis.
* Oversee the acquisition of new customers and the implementation of retention initiatives.


**Brand Management**


* Oversee the development and execution of comprehensive brand strategies to maintain and enhance brand identity.
* Direct efforts in advertising, promotions, and public relations to ensure impactful campaigns.


**Market Analysis and Adaptation**


* Stay abreast of industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activities.
* Utilize data and market research to identify opportunities and inform strategic decisions.


**Compliance and Governance**


* Ensure all sales and marketing strategies comply with corporate governance policies and procedures.
* Actively mitigate legal risks associated with advertising, promotions, and sales practices.
* Maintain compliance with relevant laws and regulations across all sales and marketing activities.


**Technological Advancements**


* Maximize the efficacy of sales and marketing operations using technological tools like CRM systems.
* Implement technological advancements to streamline operations and improve efficiency.


**Performance and Budget Management**


* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for both sales and marketing.
* Utilize performance metrics to assess the overall effectiveness of strategies and campaigns.
* Develop and manage budgets, ensuring cost\-effective resource allocation to maximize ROI.


**Collaboration and Leadership**


* Foster collaboration between sales and marketing teams to ensure a unified approach.
* Mentor and develop the leadership team within the Sales and Marketing department.
* Promote a high\-performance culture focused on achieving business goals.


**Ethical Standards and Transparency**


* Champion ethical practices across all sales and marketing activities, ensuring transparency and integrity.
* Implement policies and procedures to prevent fraud and maintain high ethical standards.
* Foster a culture of compliance with ethical guidelines and promote accountability within the department.


**Internal Control and Risk Management**


* Establish robust internal controls to prevent leakages and ensure financial integrity in sales and marketing operations.
* Conduct regular audits and reviews to monitor compliance with internal controls and identify areas for improvement.
* Implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential risks associated with sales and marketing activities.


**Innovation and Continuous Improvement**


* Drive innovation in sales and marketing strategies and processes to stay ahead of industry trends and competitors.
* Encourage a culture of innovation within the department, supporting initiatives that enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
* Evaluate new technologies and methodologies to optimize sales and marketing operations and improve ROI.


**System Policy and procedures**


* Set clear guidelines for sales practices, customer interactions, data management, and the use of marketing materials.
* Ensure data security and set guidelines defining how customer data should be handled and protected.


**Financial Management**


* Oversee the budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning of sales and marketing initiatives.
* Analyse market trends, customer behaviour, and the competitive landscape to make informed decisions that will drive revenue growth and profitability.
* Set financial targets for the department and monitor performance against these targets to meet financial objectives of the organization.


**Internal Stakeholders**


* CEO
* CFO
* CHRO
* Chief Sales Officer
* National Head Technical Services
* National Head \- B2B
* Chief Brands \& Marketing
* Chief \- Solutions \& Products
* Head Pricing \& Margin
* Head \- Sales \& Market Development and PMO
* Head \- Analytics \& Demand Planning


**External Stakeholders**


* Sales Promoters
* Institutional Buyers
* Regulatory Bodies
* Trade Associations

### **Qualifications**


**Educational Qualification:**


* Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA), Marketing, or a related field


**Work Experience (Range of years):**


* 20\+ years of experience in sales and marketing, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.


**Industry Knowledge:**


* Experience in the cement or manufacturing industry is highly preferred. Demonstrated success in leading large, diverse teams and managing multiple functions.
